+# vim: ft=python fileencoding=utf-8 sts=4 sw=4 et:
+
+"""Tests for end-to-end test markers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('version, webengine, skipped', [
+    ('5.11', True, False),
+    ('5.12', True, True),
+    ('5.14', True, True),
+    ('5.15', True, False),
+    ('5.13', False, False),
+])
+def test_js_headers_marker(request, monkeypatch, version, webengine, skipped):
+    conftest_path = str(Path(__file__).with_name('conftest.py'))
+    conftest = request.config.pluginmanager.get_plugin(conftest_path)
+    assert conftest is not None
+
+    def version_check(required, compiled=True):
+        return tuple(map(int, version.split('.'))) >= tuple(
+            map(int, required.split('.')))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(conftest.qtutils, 'version_check', version_check)
+    item = mock.Mock()
+    item.get_closest_marker.side_effect = (
+        lambda name: pytest.mark.js_headers.mark if name == 'js_headers'
+        else None)
+
+    conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems(
+        SimpleNamespace(webengine=webengine), [item])
+
+    skip_marks = [call.args[0] for call in item.add_marker.call_args_list
+                  if call.args[0].mark.name == 'skipif']
+    assert bool(skip_marks) == skipped
